explication: AI4AnimationPy is a Python framework for motion-capture processing, neural-network training and inference, and character-animation visualization. A typical workflow imports motion, builds animation features, trains or runs a model, then applies predicted motion to a character in the ECS scene and optionally renders it. The README also documents standalone, headless, and manual execution, motion editing, IK, and rendering capabilities. The graph combines these documented capabilities with sampled demo behavior; some subsystem wiring is documented rather than visible in the excerpts.
